experiment_data.hypothesis: Zero-shot LLM baseline: DeepSeek V3.2 直接判断文本递归生成深度 (4-class)，无需统计特征提取。作为 upper-bound baseline 对比 feature-based 方法。

spec.eval_data: 200 random samples from Pythia nucleus d0-d3 (50 per depth)

metrics.note: 44.3% well above chance (25%) but far below RF 78.2% (-33.9pp). Zero-shot LLM cannot reliably distinguish recursive depth from raw text alone.

experiment_data.notes: DeepSeek V3.2 zero-shot 4-class acc=44.3% (200 samples, 50/depth)。高于 chance 25% (+19.3pp) 但远低于 RF 78.2% (-33.9pp)。结论：即使最强 LLM 也无法从原始文本可靠判断递归深度——统计特征提取是必要的，这验证了本文 feature-based 方法的价值。Paper Agent 可从 registry 读取此结果用于 Baselines 对比表。
